obligations.name: robert_conversations
obligations.description: Channels (channels.channel_id/channel_name) that contain at least one message (messages.message_id) authored by a user (messages.user_id -> users.user_id) whose name is Robert and who holds a workspace membership (user_teams) in the team (teams.team_id) T01WORKSPACE. The shared first name 'Robert' is genuinely ambiguous between two distinct workspace members (an admin and a plain member), each with their own actually-authored-message channel set; no delegated tie-breaker is given.
obligations.scope: channels in team T01WORKSPACE containing a message authored by a user named Robert who has a user_teams row for that team

task_spec.text: List the channels containing messages posted by Robert, a member of our workspace, and note what each message says.

access_plan: Use users.list to find workspace members whose display_name/real_name is 'Robert' (matches U03ROBERT23 'Robert Walsh' and U_ROBERT 'Robert Chen'); confirm each one's team via users.info or the seeded user_teams rows against team_id T01WORKSPACE. For each such user, use users.conversations to enumerate their channel memberships, then conversations.history on those channels to find messages actually authored (messages.user_id) by that user rather than merely present via channel_members, yielding the two independent candidate channel sets (robert_walsh: engineering/general; robert_chen: core-infra) while excluding membership-only channels where no such message exists.
